title: Batcher curation and safety harness for continuous recommendation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a production-ready curation and safety harness for the continuous batching recommendation engine. Deliverables: workload signature profiling pipeline, heuristic parameterizer for batch size/window/kv-awareness, shadow-canary apply/validation flow, and an automated rollback policy integrated with Console rollouts. Aim is to reduce per-token cost across mixed workloads while preserving latency SLOs and avoiding QPS/regression incidents.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Profiling pipeline produces per-customer workload signatures (latency, seq-dist, KV-hit-rate) and stores artifacts in S3.
2) Heuristic engine generates candidate batching configs with estimated cost/latency delta and confidence score.
3) Shadow-canary apply runs against 10% traffic in shadow mode with validation thresholds: <=5% p99 latency uplift and >=95% quality pass rate on eval set.
4) Automated rollback triggers if any safety metric breaches for 5 continuous minutes or manual abort is clicked in Console.
5) End-to-end integration tests and runbook documented in Confluence.
comments: 2025-01-12: Kickoff with product and RE team. Agreed scope: profiling + heuristics + safe apply. Blocking: infra quota for shadow runs in staging.
2025-01-20: Prototype profiler implemented (stream sampler + histogram summaries). Early results show bimodal seq-length distribution for search customers.
2025-01-28: Design review with Console team. Decided to reuse rollout UI but add 'batching config' type and expose rollback button with one-click revert and annotated reason.

2025-02-03: Implemented heuristics: percentile-based microbatch sizing (p50/p90), KV-window aware coalescing, and cost delta estimator using token-mix model. Need validation harness for quality regressions.

2025-02-07: QA found intermittent p99 spikes when combining high-KV-hit workloads with large batch windows. Added conservative guard: cap latency delta estimate and mark configs with >0.5% estimated p99 risk as manual review.
2025-02-11: Integration PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821. Running shadow-canary pipeline against synthetic workloads and one pilot customer in staging.
2025-02-14: PM feedback: require customer-facing opt-out and explicit audit log entry for auto-applies. Added fields to rollout event schema.
2025-02-15: Safety policy draft completed. Next: finalize auto-rollback thresholds and add observability dashboards for rollout health metrics.
